name: dropwatch
description: Dropwatch — never overpay again. Track product prices and get alerted on drops.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
